verdicts.reason: Both crop the photo down to a mouth and chin, so the face and the original's 'looking up at ideas' story are gone. Most doodles shrink to specks, and all the text is tiny at 320x50. A pushes 'HOW IT WORKS?' against the edge of the photo, where it nearly collides with the chin. Its 'PODCAST WITH HARRY LEE HOFFMAN' is jammed right next to the headline with a question-mark doodle squeezed beside it, which makes a cramped cluster. B keeps the headline on clean white, which reads better. But it wraps the subtitle into an awkward three-line stack hugging the right edge, and a molecule doodle floats loose between the two text blocks. B is marginally less colliding.
